Bldgs.6& 7 PARTY WALL DECLARATION OF RESTRICTIONS, made as of this 15th day of July, 2002, by Landmark Projects IV, Inc., having offices at 250 Park Avenue South, New York, NY 10003 (hereinafter referred to as the “Developer") and NYC Partnership Housing Development Fund Company, Inc., having offices at One Battery Park Plaza, New York, New York 10004, (hereinafter referred to as the “NYCP") (Developer and NYCP are hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Declarants"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, NYCP is the owner of the real property in borough of Manhattan as described onSchedule“A"Block1928Lot7and Block1928Lot 107,New York,NY, annexed hereto and made a part hereof, upon which Developer intends to build two new three family-four story townhouses; WHEREAS, the Developer has built two residential buildings in such a manner that eachof thebuildings shall adjoin the other and shall beconnectedtoeach otherby a commonParty Wall ("Party Wall"); WHEREAS the Declarants desire to declare the following restrictions, covenants and agreements governing said Party Wall; and WHEREAS,thehome designated asBlock1928Lot7islocated at street address 269 West 122nd Street, New York, N.Y.and the home on the other side of the Party Wall is designated as Block 1928 Lot 107 and is located at street address 267 West 123rd Street, New York, NY; NOW THEREFORE, the following declaration of restrictions, covenants and agreements shall run with the land and be binding upon the Declarants herein, their heirs, owner of Block 1928 Lot 7 and of Block 1928 Lot 107, New York,N.Y. and the heirs, successors and assigns of each such subsequent owner. 1. ThePartyWall was constructed in such afashion as tobe located an equal distance on or over the respective adjoining lots with the midline of the Party Wall being located as nearly as possible on the common boundary line and it is understood that minor variations may be present due to topographical problems or construction requirements. 2. The PartyWall shall be used and maintained as a PartyWall forever and the owner of the lot on each side of thePartyWall,shall belicensed and permittedto enter upon the premises of the owner on the other side of the Party Wall to make intentions to do so.
